page.notes: Catchword "Hinc" is at the lower right and is not part of the text. Marginal notes at "Ariani" and "Rogamus" were read from a small, blurred print. "populum" and the abbreviation after "Lib. 5." are doubtful. The note "epist. 2." is doubtful. The italic and capital-letter settings in the long sentences are approximate. Ambrose's "Dico paratum" is doubtful. Some Latin words in the notes may be misread because the scan is low resolution.
